author: nc1234
content:
I think this is worth flagging. `execution_payload_availability[F]` is always 1. I think what we need is 
```
        execution_payload_availability=ExecutionPayloadAvailability([
            0b0 if index == pre.slot % SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT else 0b1
            for index in range(SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT)
        ]),
```
at fork transition

author: nc1234
content: There is also one issue that at fork transition we set `state.latest_execution_payload_bid.slot` to 0 [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/f221a044e575fc8d7b400e9cf4061e8c11db6730/specs/gloas/fork.md?plain=1#L207), which means `parent_slot` [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/f221a044e575fc8d7b400e9cf4061e8c11db6730/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1665) is 0 and `payload_index` [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/f221a044e575fc8d7b400e9cf4061e8c11db6730/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1311) is always 1 for block at F.

author: nero_eth
content: Yeah it seems like there could be an issue but afaict no rewards for correct votes is everything that happens. So, might be fine to ignore?

author: potuz
content: Because all slots pre fork are guaranteed to be full, we set them to zero post fork at process slot cause there's no guarantee the payload will arrive

author: potuz
content: I think using the slot in the bid is ugly anyway here. The slot in the bid was included to help during gossip. It's semantically correct to have an empty bid at the fork. The slot imo should come from the latest block header which was always considered to be the parent block in the stf. This means that the slot needs to be cached when processing the header

author: dapplion
content: To clarify for Gloas optimistic sync:

author: dapplion
content: - INVALID payload for block N — does only the (N, FULL) node die, leaving (N, EMPTY) and its descendants viable? Or does block N die outright? And do descendants that chose FULL die with it?

author: dapplion
content: - Optimistic payload — Should be marked as FULL-but-unvalidated, or held at EMPTY/PENDING until the EL resolves?

author: dapplion
content: - What exactly goes in sync/optimistic.md for Gloas?

author: potuz
content: 1) (N, Empty) is viable and all its descendants are viable.

author: potuz
content: for 2) we mark the full node as optimistic, and the empty node depends. if it's parent hash is valid we mark it as valid, if its parent hash is optimistic we mark it as optimistic as well

author: m.kalinin
content: Optimistic sync spec should be switched from a tree of blocks to tree of nodes and updated for Gloas

author: nc1234
content: If you put it this way then yeah. But it's a misalignment of incentive. It basically says, for this block, you will get a reward unconditionally if you do data.index === 1.  It goes the other way too, if F-1 slot is missed, then F-2's committee's head flag will be lost because fulu attestation data index is always 0.
